description: This file implements a network communication channel for the ttrpc protocol, including message header handling, message sending and receiving, and buffer management.

classes.name: channel
classes.description: Represents a network channel for ttrpc communication, managing connection, buffers, and message I/O.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives a message from the channel, returning the message header, payload, and error if any.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message with specified stream ID, type, flags, and payload over the channel.

methods.name: getmbuf
methods.description: Allocates or reuses a buffer of the specified size for message payload.

methods.name: putmbuf
methods.description: Returns a buffer to the pool for reuse.
